provisional_findings.title: Pairing can durably commit a device before credential custody is established
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on delivery/restart failure after durable approval but before client custody; local revoke/re-pair recovers.

provisional_findings.title: Mobile WebSocket commands bypass granted chat/media scopes
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on a valid owner credential whose durable scopes are narrower than the command; default owner pairing grants broad scopes.

provisional_findings.title: Refresh rotation can strand a paired device on ambiguous delivery
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on replacement-response loss after rotation invalidates old refresh/access state.

provisional_findings.title: Versioned mobile route contract contradicts the production edge
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic contract drift: declared HTTP bootstrap/mutation/attachment/logout routes are not served by the production edge.

provisional_findings.title: Isolated mobile data server exercises materially different authorization and recovery semantics
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic qualification mismatch; bounded to staging/fixture fidelity rather than an ordinary product caller.

provisional_findings.title: Systemd supervision reports applied success without checking command success
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on nonzero systemctl results in the explicit opt-in supervision CLI.

provisional_findings.title: Pairing can proceed without a verified Tailscale Serve mapping
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on negative/incorrect Serve readiness plus UI fallback; owner approval/token authorization remain required.

provisional_findings.title: Manual 8-digit pairing cannot survive Android process/activity recreation after collection
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on process/plugin recreation while manual approval is pending.

provisional_findings.title: Mobile HTTP completions can arrive before request correlation is armed
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional timing race between native completion and request-ID waiter installation.

provisional_findings.title: A valid large WebSocket frame can permanently wedge the JNI event pump
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on an accepted frame whose encoded event exceeds JNI retrieval capacity.

provisional_findings.title: Android logcat receives replayable signed-media bearer capabilities
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on log access plus network reachability; signed URL has no embedded expiry/separate API token.

provisional_findings.title: Global native last_error storage is unsafe under concurrent Android calls
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on overlapping failing native/JNI calls.

provisional_findings.title: Bounded broker event pressure can silently drop admitted operation completions
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on post-admission event-queue saturation.

provisional_findings.title: The 512 MiB native media-cache budget is enforced only after unbounded single-file writes
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on sufficiently large/concurrent full media streams; completed entries are trimmed later.

provisional_findings.title: Phone-side Pairing Cancel is not durable and can resume into approval after restart
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on persisted QR/link pending pairing plus Cancel/restart and later owner approval.

provisional_findings.title: Release signing material is exposed to dependency-rich pre-sign build steps
provisional_findings.qualification: Conditional on compromised build-time dependency/process; exposure to unrelated pre-sign child processes is deterministic.

provisional_findings.title: The pinned mobile toolchain accepts stale/unverified cached tools and an ambient Bun
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic qualification gap: cached tool existence and ambient Bun can bypass the recorded lock.

provisional_findings.title: Gradle wrapper distribution is not cryptographically pinned
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic build-integrity gap: distributionSha256Sum is absent.

provisional_findings.title: Desktop-parity checker silently skips async inbound-command and misc-route source coverage
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic checker blind spot: AsyncFunctionDef production surfaces are not extracted.

provisional_findings.title: Update-persistence qualification reinstalls the same APK instead of exercising an actual upgrade
provisional_findings.qualification: Deterministic test-design gap: baseline and candidate are the same artifact.
